chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Bilal al-Muhalabi narrated to me, saying: Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Asad al-Isfahani narrated to us, saying: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us, saying: Isma'il ibn Yasar narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Milh narrated to us, from Abdul Wahhab ibn Ibrahim al-Azdi, from Abu Sadiq, from Mazahim ibn Abdul Warith, from Muhammad ibn Zakariyya, from Shu'ayb ibn Waqid al-Muzani, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, the client of Sulayman ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, from his father, from Qays, the servant of Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, who said:

Indeed, Ali, the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, was near the mountain at Siffin when the Maghrib prayer arrived, so he went far away, then later came back to the camp, and it was as if the traces of weeping were on his face. He was asked: 'Did something happen to you?' He said: 'I went into seclusion and prayed to God, may He be exalted. Then a man appeared before me with a white face, and he said to me: "Peace be upon you, O successor of the last of the prophets!"'

I asked: 'Who are you, may God have mercy on you?' He said: 'I am Sham'oon, the successor of Isa, son of Maryam. O Commander of the Faithful, you have with your Lord a lofty station, the like of which no other servant of God possesses. O Commander of the Faithful, fight these sinful people, for you will assuredly triumph. O Commander of the Faithful, you are in the hereafter my companion and the companion of your brother and cousin — the Messenger of God.'

Then the man vanished from his place. Ammar ibn Yasir, Abu al-Haytham ibn al-Tayhan, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, Ubadah ibn al-Samit, Khuzaymah ibn Thabit, and Hashim al-Mirqal stood up — among a group of partisans of the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him — and they had heard the man's words.

Then Ammar ibn Yasir, Abu al-Haytham ibn al-Tayhan, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, Ubadah ibn al-Samit, Khuzaymah ibn Thabit, and Hashim al-Mirqal stood up — among a group of partisans of the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him — and they had heard the man's words. They said: 'O Commander of the Faithful, who is this man?' The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said to them: 'This is Sham'oon, the successor of Isa, peace be upon him. God sent him to give me patience in fighting His enemies.' They said to him: 'May our fathers and mothers be your ransom! By God, we shall surely support you as we supported the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, and no one among the Emigrants and Helpers shall desert you except the wretched.' Then the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, spoke to them graciously.

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Amir al-Mu'minin: Commander of the Faithful, the title of Imam Ali (AS)
key_terms.المهاجرين والأنصار: Al-Muhajirin wa al-Ansar: the Emigrants from Mecca and the Helpers of Medina, the earliest Muslim community
key_terms.شمعون: Sham'oon (Simon): identified as the successor (wasi) of Prophet Isa (Jesus), peace be upon him
key_terms.صفين: Siffin: the site of a major battle between Imam Ali (AS) and Mu'awiya's forces in 37 AH
key_terms.وصي: Wasi: successor, executor of a prophet's spiritual and temporal authority

ai.seo_question: What happened when Sham'oon, the successor of Prophet Isa (Jesus), appeared to Imam Ali at the Battle of Siffin?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Amali of al-Shaykh al-Mufid narrates an extraordinary event at the Battle of Siffin. While Imam Ali (AS) was praying alone near a mountain, a mysterious figure appeared, greeted him as the successor of the last Prophet, and delivered words of encouragement. He declared that Ali held a lofty rank with God, promised him victory in the afterlife, and urged him to fight the enemy without fear. After the figure vanished, prominent companions including Ammar ibn Yasir, Abu al-Haytham ibn al-Tayhan, Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, and others asked Imam Ali about the stranger's identity. He revealed it was Sham'oon (Simon), the successor of Prophet Isa (Jesus), sent by God to encourage him. The companions pledged their unwavering support, and Imam Ali responded graciously. The narrative highlights the theological connection between the successors of different prophets.
